description: AGSC-00-21 and AGSC-00-22 as added at rc.6. A Bundle carries a name this specification RESERVES to 1.1 (`weights`, the weighted-Links key of AGSC-00-25) beside a vendor key (`x-acme-note`, AGSC-02-05a). A 1.0 engine must not fail on either, must warn about exactly one of them, and must give both back unchanged through every path that claims to preserve. Derivation, case by case. (1) `lint`: `weights` is an unknown but well-formed key, so it is the warning AGSC-E207 (AGSC-02-05); `x-acme-note` matches `^x-[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)+$`, so AGSC-02-05a forbids any diagnostic for it. There is no error, so the AGSC-09-11 envelope is `status: pass` and the exit code is 0 (AGSC-09-08: findings that are warnings are not a failed gate), and `build` therefore succeeds. (2) `lint --fix`: the emitted key order is AGSC-04-19's schema order — the top-level `properties` order of schema/item.schema.json (type, title, description, ..., prov, ..., uses, ...), of which this file carries type, title, description, prov, uses, in that order; then the concept branch's own properties, of which it carries none beyond `type` and `description`; then the keys the schema does not know, in code-point order, which puts `weights` (U+0077) before `x-acme-note` (U+0078). Inside `prov` the order is that $def's properties order, origin before operator. The value of `weights` is reproduced exactly as authored, indentation included: no schema knows its members, so there is no order for the fix to impose, and AGSC-04-20 forbids inventing one. Nothing else moves, nothing is added, removed or inferred. (3) `export --markdown`: AGSC-01-26 emits the lint-normalised Bundle itself and must be lossless for every authored key, so the exported file is byte-for-byte the file of case (2). This is the round trip AGSC-00-22 requires, and the case that would have caught a writer that silently drops what it does not understand. The item states `kind: principle` (corrected in place at rc.6, 2026-09-24, before any tag carried this vector): a `concept` without `kind` is `AGSC-E202` under AGSC-02-12, so the whole-item lint could not hold `exit: 0`; `principle` carries no section obligation, and in schema order (AGSC-04-19) `kind`, a member of the concept branch, follows every top-level key and precedes the unknown keys.
